name: aora-bot-workspace
description: Procedural character engine and research documentation site

scripts.build:lib: pnpm --filter @aora-bot/engine build && pnpm --filter @aora-bot/element build && pnpm --filter @aora-bot/react build && pnpm --filter @aora-bot/surfaces build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @aora-bot/engine test && pnpm --filter @aora-bot/element test && pnpm --filter @aora-bot/react test && pnpm --filter @aora-bot/surfaces test && vitest run --dir api
scripts.check: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm --filter @aora-bot/docs build
